+"""Camera-guided CloseDrawer controller. Uses only the standard robot client.
+
+Run interactively; each JSON line requests an observation or explicit control
+segments. All observations and commanded actions are retained beside this file.
+"""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+(OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+cams = list(spec['cameras'])
+counter = 0
+
+def save(res):
+    global counter
+    path = OUT / f'obs_{counter:03d}'
+    res.save(str(path))
+    board = Image.new('RGB', (640, 520))
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
+    for i, (cam, arr) in enumerate(res.last.items()):
+        x, y = (i % 2)*320, (i // 2)*260
+        board.paste(Image.fromarray(arr), (x, y+20))
+        draw.text((x+4, y+4), cam, fill='white')
+    board.save(path / 'views.png')
+    print(json.dumps({'saved':str(path), 'meta':res.meta}), flush=True)
+    counter += 1
+
+print(json.dumps({'spec': spec}), flush=True)
+save(r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video='none'))
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        cmd = json.loads(line)
+        with (OUT / 'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:
+            f.write(json.dumps(cmd)+'\n')
+        if cmd['op'] == 'observe':
+            res = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True,
+                            seconds=cmd.get('seconds', 0), video='none')
+        elif cmd['op'] == 'act':
+            rows = []
+            for segment in cmd['segments']:
+                row = np.zeros(12)
+                row[6] = segment.get('grip', -1)
+                row[11] = segment.get('mode', -1)
+                for k, v in segment.get('values', {}).items():
+                    row[int(k)] = v
+                rows.extend([row.copy() for _ in range(segment['n'])])
+            actions = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
+            np.save(OUT / f'actions_{counter:03d}.npy', actions)
+            res = r.submit('ee_delta', actions, cameras=cams,
+                           include_depth=True, video='none',
+                           note=cmd.get('note','camera-guided control'))
+        elif cmd['op'] == 'stop':
+            break
+        else:
+            raise ValueError('unknown command')
+        save(res)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(json.dumps({'error':str(exc)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch"));
